core_question: How do I get dried candle wax out of a tablecloth or clothing? (secondary: How do you get rid of aphids infesting your garden plants?)
answer_summary: Scrape off hardened excess wax, sandwich the fabric between paper towels, and press with a warm iron so the remaining wax melts and is absorbed into the paper.; after the topic shift: Spray affected leaves (top and underside) with insecticidal soap or diluted neem oil, or knock aphids off with a strong jet of water, repeating every few days until the infestation clears; introducing ladybugs also helps.
